subject: Biotechnology
title: Biological Pest Control
description: Learn Biological Pest Control in one minute.

hook.text: Release engineered sterile insects — they mate with wild pests but produce no offspring. Population crashes.

buildup.text: The sterile insect technique irradiates male insects — released in millions, they outcompete wild males.

discovery.text: Oxitec's modified mosquitoes carry a self-limiting gene — their offspring inherit a lethal gene and die before adulthood.

twist.text: Wolbachia bacteria make male mosquitoes infertile when mating with wild females — no genetic modification needed.

climax.text: Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes reduced dengue cases by 77% in a city-wide trial in Yogyakarta, Indonesia.

punchline.text: Fight pests with biology, not chemicals — engineered insects reshape pest control.

quiz.question: How do Oxitec's modified mosquitoes reduce pest populations?
options: They release a toxin that kills other mosquitoes on contact
Their offspring inherit a self-limiting gene that causes death before adulthood
They eat the larvae of wild mosquitoes in breeding sites
